The local boxprobe directly exercises the real runtime and collector but is not a Pystachy JIT/AOT program build. Native JIT/AOT, full GC matrices and full make verify are exact-tree workflow evidence and are not relabeled local.

Import totals are carried forward by unchanged compiler/library/inventory identity, not freshly rerun. A runtime allocation-class reduction does not establish a new import, API, package or port success.
The performance and memory figures are attributed PR measurements. This audit independently reproduced the allocation/liveness contract, not the benchmark suite.
No full CPython regrtest was run and no broad Python, PyPI or NumPy compatibility claim follows.
